name: yell-at-claude
description: Installs the yell-at-claude plugin — automatic pushback when Claude says it can't do something or can't find something

plugins.name: yell-at-claude
plugins.description: When Claude ends a reply with "I can't" or "I couldn't find it," this plugin yells at it for you — try another spelling, check another source, use a different tool — until it actually finishes the job.
